stories.title: Man wounded during argument on northwest side; police unsure who fired gun
stories.summary: A 42-year-old man was hospitalized after a shooting on Fredericksburg Road Tuesday morning. No arrests have been made.

stories.title: Spotted: Adventurous young jaguar could make Thanksgiving debut at San Antonio Zoo
stories.summary: Eight-month-old Mary Pat has arrived from Arizona, bringing a brave, playful personality as keepers help her settle into her new home.

stories.title: Missing 12-year-old boy found safe, authorities say
stories.summary: The boy last seen near Alamo Ranch was found safe, authorities day

stories.title: Twice the tiny rhino joy: Twuda and Conrad find friendship at Natural Bridge Wildlife Ranch
stories.summary: Born less than seven weeks apart, the southern white rhino calves are growing up together — a playful payoff for decades of conservation work.

stories.title: Two found dead in suspected murder-suicide on west side, Sheriff Salazar says
stories.summary: Bexar County authorities are investigating a shooting in the 1300 block of Frontier Eagle, near Dove Canyon.

stories.title: Dog rescued from Gettysburg mobile home fire visits firefighters who saved him
stories.summary: The Gettysburg Fire Department said it rescued the dog and two other pets from a fire along the 100 block of Clapsaddle Road on Sunday.

stories.title: One win from hosting the championship: UTSA welcomes Tulsa for Senior Day showdown
stories.summary: The Roadrunners can secure home-field advantage for the American Conference championship with a victory Friday. Kickoff is at 11 a.m. at the Alamodome on ESPN.

stories.title: Questions remain after deadly tanker crash and fire on Houston's Eastex Freeway
stories.summary: A deadly tanker fire on Houston's Eastex Freeway destroyed key clues about its cargo and prompted an inspection of the overpass.

stories.title: Proposed federal fee could drive up registration costs for Texas electric vehicle owners
stories.summary: Congress is considering a $130 annual fee for fully electric vehicles, which would be in addition to the current Texas-required $200 a year registration fee.

stories.title: Gillespie County sheriff investigates vandalism at Stonewall Catholic church
stories.summary: Investigators believe someone threw a rock at the stained glass, causing the damage. A derogatory note was also found on church property.

stories.title: VIA, DoSeum partner to teach children how to navigate San Antonio on public transit
stories.summary: Geared toward children aged five to seven, the sold-out, three-day camp teaches children how to navigate San Antonio’s public transportation system.

stories.title: San Antonio residents can help shape Marbach Road safety improvements at second community workshop
stories.summary: The event, put on by the city's transportation department, will be held from 6 to 8 p.m. on Tuesday, Dec. 8, at the St. Rose of Lima Catholic Church.
